# Surface Reconstruction Metrics {#surface-reconstruction-metrics}

Chamfer-style accuracy/completeness and F-score are standard ways to compare
reconstructed surfaces with reference geometry; see the cited metric and
VIN-NBV literature [@VIN-NBV-frahm2025]. This page is a bibliography and
navigation aid, not the owner of ARIA-NBV's metric equations or RRI contract.

Use the [Typst thesis](../../typst/thesis/main.typ) for the canonical
scientific formulation and Python docstrings/tests for executable metric
behavior and validation.
